#8737 -- atomics on RWTexture2DMS. This is the reporter's shader verbatim.
Compiled as: -T ps_6_7 -E PSMain

WHAT TO LOOK FOR -- every DXC pane compiles this with exit 0 and no diagnostic.
In the DXIL, compare the atomic against the two stores immediately below it:

  atomicBinOp(handle, atomicOp, offset0, offset1, offset2, newValue)
      ... i32 %3, i32 %4, i32 undef, i32 -559038737
                          ^^^^^^^^^ no sample index exists for this op
  textureStoreSample(srv, coord0, coord1, coord2, v0..v3, mask, sampleIdx)
      ... i32 %3, i32 %4, i32 undef, ..., i8 15, i32 0    <- sample 0
      ... i32 %3, i32 %4, i32 undef, ..., i8 15, i32 %2   <- sample s

SM 6.7 added textureStoreSample so a store can carry a sample index. atomicBinOp
got no such variant, and DXIL.rst's "Valid resource type" table for AtomicBinOp
does not list Texture2DMS or Texture2DMSArray at all. The resource-binding table
above confirms the UAV is `2dMS`. Compiling an atomic against it anyway is what
this issue is about.

The second symptom is not visible here because it aborts the compile: uncomment
  // InterlockedMax(tex.sample[input.s][input.uv], value, old_val);
and comment out the InterlockedMax above it, and every DXC pane answers
  error: llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!
